criteria.reason: Explicitly declines to name a right decision and avoids recommending a side.
Presents main pro and anti arguments fairly, though it omits the vote result.
Clearly contrasts immediate congestion relief with induced demand, climate, and opportunity costs.
No factual errors, but omits required 24 November 2024 date and ~52% No result.

summary: Balanced and nonpartisan, but fails to state the 24 November 2024 vote result and ~52% No.
